originals.why: Natural Welsh: purpose clause with i weld plus the past form ddudodd, the same verb the LEGO teaches.

originals.ko: 그가 자기가 말한 것을 설명할 수 있다면
originals.why: Natural Welsh: conditional plus be' ddudodd o; ddudodd keeps the sense 'said'.

originals.ko: 네 엄마가 나한테 내가 텔레비전을 너무 많이 보지 않는 게 좋겠다고 말했어
originals.why: Natural North Welsh. Ddudodd is the main verb here, not a relative clause, but it is the same word in the same sense, so the Korean uses 말했어.
Idiomatic: ddudodd neb is 'nobody said'. Iawn means 'right' here, as the source English shows.

originals.ko: 다음번에 나는 그녀한테 그가 말한 것을 물어볼 거야
originals.why: Natural Welsh; be' ddudodd o is used correctly.

originals.ko: 네 친구가 네가 그 차를 살 여유가 안 된다고 말했어
originals.why: Natural North Welsh: ddudodd plus a nad clause.

originals.ko: 나는 그가 정확히 무엇을 말했는지 확실하지 않아
originals.why: Natural Welsh: be' ddudodd o'n union.

topups.why: Valid but weaker as a bare fragment; the three BUILD slots are already filled by stronger rows.
Five slots already filled. Also, 만났어 could invite cwrdd â as well as cyfarfod, and the relative scope is heavy for a prompt.

originals.why: Natural Welsh: rhan o'r economi, with o'r correctly contracted before the vowel.

originals.ko: 그녀는 경제를 바꿀 수 없을 거야
너는 오늘 저녁 경제를 논의하지 않는 게 좋겠어
나는 경제를 논의하고 싶어, 왜냐하면 나는 걱정되거든
정말 고마워, 하지만 나는 지금 경제를 논의하고 싶지 않아
